incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — service=generate-api | metric=p99_latency | window=5m | value=1.89s | SLO burn=true | incident=PD-4821 | region=us-west. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4821

pagerduty: Incident PD-4821 acknowledged by alice

alice: acked, oncall here. starting triage. anyone seeing errors or just tail latency?

ben: I'm on metrics. p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms -> p99 spiked to 1.9s over last 6m. no elevated 5xx in logs. looks like tail-only.

carla: infra check: autoscaler did not add nodes for last burst. pending scaleup blocked by quota. checking quota now.

dinesh: platform note: we have a compatible model fallback model-small-2 that trades quality for latency. can route traffic while we mitigate.

alice: can we try routing 25% traffic to model-small-2 as a canary? if it cuts tail we'll ramp.

ben: good plan. I'm going to confirm that model-small-2 is in the catalog and latency profile.

ben: model-small-2 available, p99 ~400ms in bench. I'll update routing via feature flag.

alice: applying routing: 

alice: ```
# rollout via router service
curl -X POST https://router.internal/run -d '{"route":"/generate-api","fallback":"model-small-2","pct":25}'
```

carla: infra: requested +2 gpus in us-west, pending due to quota. opened ticket with cloud provider.

pagerduty: PD-4821 status: acknowledged by alice, assigned to eng-oncall

ben: routing change applied. starting to see p99 drop in primary by ~30% in first 90s.

alice: customer-impact check: downstream telemetry shows degraded completions for 4.2% of requests, not full failures. posting to status if persists.

dinesh: also enabling prefix KV caching for hot routes as short-term: toggling cache=true for /generate-api

ben: cache toggle done. combined routing+cache: p99 now ~980ms and falling.

alice: great. continuing to watch. if p99 < 1.2s for 10m we can close PD and create postmortem.

carla: infra update: cloud quota approved, autoscaler scaling +2 gpus applied, nodes registering.

ben: nodes online, model replicas warming. p99 stabilized ~720ms. tail looks much better.

incident-bot: PD-4821: PagerDuty incident status changed to resolved by alice

alice: resolving PD. creating follow-up ticket PM-538 to capture root cause (autoscaler/quotas + kvcache cold start). assigning to ben+carla+dinesh.

alice: leaving handoff to ben for 2hr post-ops checks. thanks all :thumbsup:

ben: got it. I'll monitor for 1 hour then update.

carla: I'll verify autoscaler policy and apply quota guardrails.

dinesh: I'll run pre-warm for KV cache and add playbook steps for model fallback routing.

alice: closing thread here — will add notes to incident doc.
